reviews.comment: A lot of the material on homeworks and exams was based off the textbook and slides which helped tremendously (although they still took awhile to complete). I requested some regrading of my work due to misunderstandings and he was really kind about it. Lectures were hard to follow due to his accent but following along his slides helped a lot.

I'm not the type to hate on professors but this guy is bad. I don't think he's properly answered one question a student has asked during lecture. I legit feel like I've learned nothing attending his lectures. His TA's also grade harshly on the HW. Don't take this guy

This guy isn't that good of a prof. He shows up to class late, and isn't very engaging with students in lecture. His HW is tough and graded strictly. However, his lecture notes are terrific and he's definitely a nice person. CLRS saved me in this class. Overall, I would avoid him. Not the worst, but there are better options.
